syscalls.comment: Full networking for Go net/http, gRPC, and service mesh sidecars. Go makes heavy use of socket syscalls via netpoller.

Core Go runtime syscalls. Includes futex (goroutine scheduler), epoll (netpoller), sigaltstack (signal handling), splice/tee (io.Copy), timerfd (runtime timers), mincore (runtime memory check). Excludes System V IPC (msgctl/msgget/msgrcv/msgsnd) as Go uses channels/goroutines instead. Excludes fork/vfork as Go uses clone exclusively.

Go runtime thread creation via clone. Go uses CLONE_VM|CLONE_FS|CLONE_FILES|CLONE_SIGHAND|CLONE_THREAD|CLONE_SYSVSEM|CLONE_SETTLS|CLONE_PARENT_SETTID|CLONE_CHILD_SETTID for goroutine M-thread scheduling. fork and vfork are excluded because Go never uses them.
x86_64 architecture-specific syscalls. arch_prctl is required by Go runtime for TLS setup (set FS/GS base register). modify_ldt included for 32-bit compatibility.
Allow only PER_LINUX personality. Prevents executing non-Linux ABIs.
Allow PER_LINUX32 for 32-bit compatibility on amd64 kernels.
getrandom for crypto/rand and TLS. rseq (restartable sequences) used by Go scheduler since Go 1.21 for faster goroutine context switching.
Timekeeping for Go time package, context deadlines, HTTP timeouts, and runtime scheduler. clock_gettime is the primary clock source; gettimeofday for legacy compatibility.
File optimization for Go services that write data files (Prometheus TSDB, Grafana dashboards). fallocate for pre-allocation, fadvise64 for access pattern hints, sync_file_range for async flush.
Cross-process memory I/O. Used by Go runtime for profiling (pprof) and debugging. Safe to allow in production; requires same-uid or CAP_SYS_PTRACE which is denied.
NUMA memory policy syscalls. Go runtime may use these for memory locality on NUMA systems (large database caches, in-memory data grids). Harmless on non-NUMA systems.
Memory barrier syscall for cross-core synchronization. Used by Go runtime for fast safe-point coordination between goroutines on different OS threads.
Resource limit queries. Go runtime queries RLIMIT_NOFILE for file descriptor limits and RLIMIT_AS for memory accounting.
POSIX shared memory for Go services using shared memory IPC (e.g., Prometheus remote-write batching, Grafana plugin communication).
